title: Updating
body:
Why don't you enable retroactive synchronization? 
For example, in the case that, for some reason, I don't sync my watch with the app on the given day, syncing it tomorrow will not add the data from yesterday.

title: Data not properly synced with badges
body:
It doesn’t always read the data properly. For example, yesterday I achieved 3 time move goal (1020 cal) inside one day but the 300% badge says I only achieved 21 cal. And new move record badge is stuck on previous move record.

I have 8 consecutive rings closed per day, but I haven’t received the reward for longest strike and and data on it says “Your current strike is 1 day”
